audit.whatIsWrong: Full-layer phases[].side is 'Skill' on all seven rows while content win[] and the packet levelChart both read Skill/Diana/Skill/Skill/Diana/Ekko/Ekko.
audit.why: Content and packet agree with each other and with the kit: Diana owns level 2 (Moonlight makes Lunar Rush free) and level 6 (100s Moonfall), Ekko owns the item stages. The full layer was never updated off the template.
audit.corrected: Full rows aligned to the content chart, with each why rewritten to argue the verdict of its own row.

audit.whatIsWrong: Every phases[].why was the generic Ekko template, so the two rows the chart gives Diana had text describing Ekko winning them.
audit.why: That is exactly the side-says-one-thing / why-says-another defect. Level 2 is hers because of the free Lunar Rush; level 6 is hers because Moonfall pulls at 475 and refreshes Pale Cascade.
audit.corrected: phases[1].why and phases[4].why now explain Diana's spike; phases[5] and [6] explain Ekko's.

audit.whatIsWrong: The decisive interaction is never stated: Lunar Rush has NO cooldown when Diana dashes to a target afflicted with Moonlight, so a landed Crescent Strike gives her a free dash on top of the 22s one.
audit.why: Riot's Lunar Rush text says exactly that. The page only said 'Moonlight marks reset her dash', which does not tell the reader that dodging the Q is what keeps her E on 22 seconds.
audit.corrected: cooldowns, tradeBad, breakdown.trading, breakdown.carry and phases[0]/[1].why now state it with the numbers.

audit.why: It is the field that must hold real cooldowns.
audit.corrected: Now carries Crescent Strike 8s, Lunar Rush 22s (free while Moonlight holds), Pale Cascade 15s, Moonfall 100s, Chronobreak 110s.

audit.whatIsWrong: Thirteen fields called Diana 'he/his/him'; dosFull[1].d was the tradeGood string and dontsFull[2].d the tradeBad string, both under unrelated titles.
audit.why: champ-gender.js marks diana female; the bodies were pasted from the trade fields.
audit.corrected: All flagged non-report fields rewritten with correct pronouns and their own content; two report entries fixed within the cap.

edits.before: Q the wave and his toes — the return pass chunks; learn the slow zone's drag on his dodge patterns.
edits.after: Q both passes and sidestep the arc — a Crescent Strike that misses leaves her Lunar Rush on a full 22s.

edits.before: E blink-strike window opens: Q-E-auto is your first real trade and the third passive hit stings already.
edits.after: A Q-marked Lunar Rush costs her no cooldown at all — at 2 she dashes in, shields, and out-trades you.

edits.before: W zone games begin: drop it on his retreat line BEFORE trading and the stun finds him mid-regret.
edits.after: Drop W on her dash line before trading — Moonlight refreshes her E, so plan for two dashes, not one.

edits.before: Three-hit trades on cooldown — Q in, E the gap, passive proc, walk. Bank the tempo for 6.
edits.after: Q in, E the gap, passive proc, walk — trade only once her 15s Pale Cascade shield is spent.

edits.before: - Diana Crescent Strike: matchup-defining — Moonlight marks reset her dash — sidestep the arc and her dive has no follow-up. Step up only on its downtime. - Budget R Chronobreak for emergencies and the R for opportunities — never swap them.
edits.after: - Crescent Strike is 8s at rank 1, and its Moonlight mark makes Lunar Rush cost no cooldown at all — sidestep the arc and her dash stays on its full 22s. - Pale Cascade shield is 15s. - Moonfall is 100s; your Chronobreak is 110s.
